task: Turn this into a task list with owners and dates for the finance team.
text:
Subject: Audit fieldwork, documents for next week

Hi team, our external auditor, Mei-Ling Tan, has sent the first request list for the year-end audit. Fieldwork starts on 9 February and she wants the fixed asset register, the bank reconciliations for months 10 to 12 and a sample of 25 purchase invoices by 4 February. Our controller, Henrik Dahl, will review everything first, so upload to the shared folder by 2 February, not 4 February. If Mei-Ling queries a sample item, call her on 020 7946 0551 rather than replying by email. The audit job reference is AUD-24-0816 and you can send the final pack to m.tan@auditors.example.com.
